question: The Italian Court of Cassation has confirmed that custody of Daniel is to be granted to Francesco Arcuri, convicted in Spain of violence against the child’s mother, Juana Rivas. The decision comes while the criminal trial against Arcuri for alleged physical and psychological ill-treatment of Daniel and his brother continues in Italy.

Daniel is thus in the custody of someone who is being tried for allegedly mistreating him. Juana Rivas complains that she has not been able to communicate with her son for a year and that he has no contact with her family either.

In May 2025, the Commission recognised that the best interests of the child, as enshrined in Article 24 of the Charter, should guide decisions affecting them and that children exposed to domestic violence are victims. In view of the above: 1.

Does the Commission consider that this situation infringes Article 24 of the Charter, Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 as regards parental responsibility and Directive (EU) 2024/1385 on combating violence against women and domestic violence?
In this context, does it maintain that there are no indications that EU law is being implemented incorrectly?
What concrete measures will it take to prevent re-victimisation and to guarantee Daniel’s safety and rights?
